<b>Rite of Rebirth</b> is a [[Wayfarer Wishes|Wayfarer Wish]] in <i>[[Hollow Knight: Silksong]]</i>, which involves [[Greyroot]] forcing [[Hornet (Silksong)|Hornet's]] shell to host the [[Twisted Bud]].

== How to Start ==
Before the Wish proper can be acquired, the Twisted Bud must be obtained. It can be found in [[Bilewater]], in a room accessible via a passage in the [[Whispering Vaults]], while Greyroot is found in [[Shellwood]].

{{Gallery
| Image1 = Mapshot SS Twisted Bud.png!The Twisted Bud's location in Bilewater
| Image2 = Screenshot SS Twisted Bud 01.png!The Twisted Bud's in its crib in Bilewater
}}

== Wish ==
[[File:Twisted Bud.png|link=Twisted Bud|left|thumb|100x100px]]

To start the wish, Hornet must speak to Greyroot while in possession of the Twisted Bud, and after having completed [[Rite of the Pollip]]. However, once this happens, Greyroot seizes Hornet's shell, and implants into her the [[Cursed Crest]], another form of the Twisted Bud. After that, the wish is completed.

{{Gallery
|Image1 = Mapshot SS Greyroot.png!Greyroot's location in Shellwood
|Image2 = Screenshot SS Greyroot 02.png!Greyroot in Shellwood
|Image3 = Screenshot SS Greyroot 01.png!Greyroot seizing Hornet
}}

== Reward ==
[[File:Cursed Crest Inventory.png|link=Cursed Crest|left|thumb|150x150px]]

Hornet wakes up some time after the quest was completed, trapped within ashen vines inside the [[Chapel of the Witch]]. These vines can be broken out of with a few hits from the [[Needle]].

From here, the Cursed Crest is bound to Hornet, unable to be changed on a Bench as normal. For more information about removing the Cursed Crest or otherwise, see its [[Cursed Crest|main page]], or <i>[[Infestation Operation]]</i>.

{{Gallery

| Image2 = Screenshot SS Rite of Rebirth 01.png!Hornet trapped in vines
}}
